description: The line plot, titled "Individual vs Ensemble Models," compares the reliability scores of three different models—3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4—across varying levels of cost. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," is also a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with major tick marks at intervals of 20. The blue line, representing the 3-Model Ensemble, starts at a reliability score of approximately 77 when the cost is 0 and shows a gradual decline to about 73 at a cost of 10. The red line, representing the 2-Model Ensemble, begins at a reliability score of approximately 78 at a cost of 0 and decreases to around 72 at a cost of 10. The yellow line, representing GPT-4, starts at a reliability score of approximately 89 at a cost of 0 and exhibits a steep decline, reaching a score of about 35 at a cost of 10. All three lines are solid and show a consistent downward trend as cost increases.
